about: Hand-correctable classification of every exchange on dartboard.bucklerfamily.estate. Keys of 'emails' are indexes into avenueEmails (src/data/avenues.ts). k: his = our email (cloud, numbered per body), theirs = their reply (fire; heart when h=1), phone = a call. g=1: generic (thanks, acknowledgement, automatic reply) shown at 40% opacity. h=1: fully satisfactory (heart). a=1: a real attachment came with the reply (diamond; details in 'diamonds'). Default when unsure: fire, not heart, with a 'doubt' note. Edit by hand and push; the board reads this file at build time.
sources: Case mail archive (wayback.bucklerfamily.estate /api, 770 records), Gmail read-only (attachment flags and names, 19–21 Oct messages), first-pass outcomes in avenues.ts. Inline signature images do not count as attachments.

18.label: Requester's own report, returned (PDF)
18.desc: The MP's office declined to act because the address is outside the Vale of Glamorgan constituency and pointed to the local MP. The PDF attached is the requester's own report, sent back with the reply.

19.reading: Nothing new was disclosed. The attachment is our own document returning. It shows the matter was redirected on constituency grounds, not looked at on its merits.

23.label: RCAHMW order form and 2025 price list
23.desc: The Royal Commission confirmed it holds 14 archives on Great House Farm, linked its Coflein entry, and attached its order form and copying price list.
23.reading: A helpful, specific answer: it names what is held and where to see it. The attachments are the standard forms for paid copies, so the records themselves still have to be viewed or bought.

69.label: HMLR holding letter
69.desc: A holding letter on title WA231076: the paper files were being retrieved.
69.reading: A process step. It confirms paper files existed for the title, which matters for what was later produced.

104.label: HMLR letter on registration history
104.desc: HM Land Registry's letter setting out the registration history of Tŷ Mawr Farm.
104.reading: A core record for our case. It sets the registry's own sequence of events, which we compare with the family papers.

110.label: HMLR stage-one complaint decision
110.desc: HM Land Registry's decision on the stage-one complaint.
110.reading: The complaint was not upheld in the way sought, so the next stage was used. It fixes the registry's stated position at that date.

114.label: HMLR stage-two acknowledgement
114.desc: An acknowledgement that the complaint had moved to stage two.
114.reading: A process step only; it starts the stage-two clock.

141.label: GGAT 1990 assessment and two 1988 survey photos
141.desc: Cadw searched its electronic records and confirmed the farmhouse and barn were assessed and not listed in the 1988 survey of Llandough. It attached two survey photos of 29 July 1988 and a 1990 GGAT archaeological assessment.
141.reading: Real disclosure, and an early one. With hindsight the photos and the 1990 assessment show the buildings were recorded before demolition. Cadw also found no record of the December 1988 revisit reported in the press, which later requests followed up.

146.label: HMLR stage-two complaint decision
146.desc: HM Land Registry's final internal decision on the complaint.
146.reading: It closed the registry's own complaint route and opened the path to the Independent Complaints Reviewer (ICR/090/26).

154.label: RCAHMW price list, licence fees and order form
154.desc: The Royal Commission sent its 2026 price list, licence fees and order form for request RC26-0205.
154.reading: Fee paperwork, not records. It shows copies of the archive are available for a charge.

208.label: RCAHMW price list, licence fees and order form (resent)
208.desc: The same fee documents for RC26-0205, sent again.
208.reading: No new material; a repeat of the fee paperwork.

213.label: ATISN 27021 response letter and two 1988 photos
213.desc: The Welsh Government's formal answer to ATISN 27021, with the two 29 July 1988 survey photos attached as documents 1 and 2.
213.reading: The photos had already come informally in May. Our reading: the formal reply adds little beyond them, which is why the review and later requests asked what paper files from 1988 survive.

230.label: Internal review acknowledgement (ATISN 27021)
230.desc: A letter acknowledging the request for an internal review of ATISN 27021.
230.reading: A process step; it starts the review clock.

252.label: ATISN 27021 internal review response
252.desc: The Welsh Government's internal review response on ATISN 27021.
252.reading: The review closed the request at Cadw level. Cadw later relied on it to refuse ATISN 27589 as a repeat (19 Oct 2026).

273.label: HMLR letter N610CGV
273.desc: An HM Land Registry letter, reference N610CGV, about title WA231076.
273.reading: Part of the registry's own paper trail on the title; read with the registration history letter of 23 March.

325.label: HMLR schedule of first-registration documents
325.desc: A schedule listing the documents lodged at first registration of WA231076 and WA240304.
325.reading: Important: it lists what the registry relied on at first registration. Our case asserts the list should be tested against the family's title papers.

404.label: Health board application form for deceased records
404.desc: Cardiff and Vale health board sent its application form and cover letter for access to a deceased person's health records.
404.reading: Not disclosure: it moves the request onto the Access to Health Records Act 1990 route, which is the correct law for a deceased patient.

464.label: Glamorgan Archives photography order form
464.desc: Glamorgan Archives sent its digital photography order form.
464.reading: Fee paperwork for copies, not records.

467.label: Bute catalogue documents (zip)
467.desc: Glamorgan Archives sent a zipped set of Bute estate catalogue documents in answer to the Tŷ Mawr enquiry. The zip itself is kept on the archive site.
467.reading: Useful finding aids: they point to the Bute and Western Ground Rents series that later evidence pages draw on (for example D696 and DBDT).

474.label: Requester's own documents, returned
474.desc: An acknowledgement of FOI 26FOI 103. The PDFs attached are the requester's own documents, carried back in the thread.
474.reading: Nothing new was disclosed by this email. The substantive answer came later (see the Wales Office 26FOI 103 response).

489.label: Glamorgan Archives photography order form

490.label: Glamorgan Archives photography order form
490.desc: Glamorgan Archives sent its digital photography order form again.

491.label: 1965 conveyance and 1965 contract
491.desc: The Vale of Glamorgan Council released a conveyance dated 11 June 1965 and a 1965 contract for the Llandough school site under FOI 00211027.
491.reading: One of the most important releases. Condition F of the 1965 contract gives a root of title in a 1938 conveyance (see EV-0216), which our case asserts bears on how the land was described after 1938.

515.label: Letter to the MP (PDF)
515.desc: The MP's office attached a letter dated September 2026 relating to the case.
515.reading: A record of the MP being asked to act; it is not disclosure of historic records.

538.label: Museum Wales FOI 2026-032 release (12 files)
538.desc: Amgueddfa Cymru released 12 files under FOI 2026-032: a 1924 image, burial data, excavation and Roman villa reports, finds lists and spreadsheets, an explanatory note, and the requester's own timeline returned.
538.reading: The largest single release on the board. It documents archaeology and finds at Llandough. Our reading: it is strong on the archaeology but does not address the title questions, which sit with other bodies.

541.label: TNA release schedules (3 CSV files)
541.desc: The National Archives released three redacted spreadsheets under CAS-347296: release schedules and a manifest for a series transfer.
541.reading: These show when records move to public catalogues. Our reading: useful for timing, but they are schedules, not the records themselves.

544.label: Glamorgan Archives photography order form
544.desc: Glamorgan Archives sent its digital photography order form again.

615.label: RCAHMW order form and price list (Welsh)

615.reading: Fee paperwork for copies, not records.

638.label: Bute 10 (catalogue document)
638.desc: Glamorgan Archives sent a further Bute catalogue document (Bute 10).
638.reading: A finding aid that points to Bute estate series relevant to the parcel history.

644.label: TNA release schedules (resent)
644.desc: The same three TNA spreadsheets, sent again with a follow-up reply.
644.reading: No new material beyond the 23 September release.

652.label: Museum Wales 63.24: 1931 letter, spur and spearhead records
652.desc: Under FOI 2026-036 Amgueddfa Cymru released accession 63.24: a 1931 letter and the records for a medieval iron spur and spearhead found at Llandough Church Farm.
652.reading: Real disclosure of historic records. It adds to the archaeology of the site; it does not speak to title.

738.desc: The Welsh Government acknowledged request ATISN 26-0010 (an .odt letter).
738.reading: A process step; the answer followed on 19 October.

774.label: ATISN 26-0010 disclosure response
774.desc: The Welsh Government's answer to ATISN 26-0010: it sets out retention schedules and states that no files were found.
774.reading: A 'not held' answer. Our reading: the retention schedules are the useful part, because they show which 1980s files should have been kept and for how long.

775.label: ATISN 27589 refusal (s.14(2))
775.desc: Cadw refused ATISN 27589 (Welsh Office and Cadw papers, July to December 1988) under FOIA s.14(2) as a repeat of ATISN 27021, and named the ICO.
775.reading: A refusal, not disclosure. Our case asserts the new request asked for different papers from a different period, so the repeat ground is open to challenge at the ICO.
